achievements.name: Escape the Underworld
achievements.detail: Defeat Hades at the end of a run and reach the surface.

achievements.name: Clear Tartarus
achievements.detail: Defeat the Fury who guards the exit from Tartarus.

achievements.name: Slay the Hydra
achievements.detail: Defeat the Bone Hydra at the end of Asphodel.

achievements.name: Elysium Champions
achievements.detail: Win the arena fight against Theseus and Asterius.

achievements.name: All Infernal Arms
achievements.detail: Unlock all six Infernal Arms in the House courtyard.

achievements.name: Offer Nectar
achievements.detail: Give Nectar to a character in the House or along a run.

achievements.name: Heat Clear
achievements.detail: Clear a run while the Pact of Punishment adds at least one Heat.

achievements.name: Pet Cerberus
achievements.detail: Pet Cerberus while he is resting in the House of Hades.

achievements.name: Minor Prophecy
achievements.detail: Complete one objective on the Fated List of Minor Prophecies.

achievements.name: Weapon Aspect
achievements.detail: Unlock an Aspect for any Infernal Arm.

achievements.name: Keepsake Equipped
achievements.detail: Equip a Keepsake before you leave the House on a run.

achievements.name: First Catch
achievements.detail: Catch a fish from a fishing point during a run.

achievements.name: Closing Resolution
achievements.detail: Reach the story's final resolution after enough successful escapes.
